frame_heading.description: The heading of the expenditure frame on the left page (支出済額); the column years are the first line of year digits below it.

left_columns.description: The left page's columns in order of their year digits: an amount heading, or `ratio` for a column of percentages.

right_columns.description: The right page's columns, as left_columns.

bracketed.description: A column whose bracketed numbers are another amount (the table's note: `※（ ）内は翌年度繰越額で外数`): the column and the heading of the bracketed amount.

balances.description: Amounts each row must balance: a heading and the headings that add up to it (予算現額 = 支出済額 + 不用額 + 翌年度繰越額). A number read into the wrong column breaks it, and the conversion stops.
